summary: Master contract management with our comprehensive Contract Administration Training Course. Gain practical skills and knowledge to excel in your profession.
lede: Contract administration covers the controls used to track supplier obligations and performance from award through closeout. It is designed for professionals managing post-award contracts, supplier delivery, and contract records, and develops practical skills in interpreting clauses, monitoring service levels, controlling variations, validating invoices, and documenting claims. Participants also work with contract registers, performance dashboards, issue logs, and closeout records to support evidence-based decisions and final account reconciliation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage post-award obligations, supplier performance, and contract records in operational settings.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of procurement, contract terms, or project delivery processes. Familiarity with contract clauses, purchase orders, supplier invoices, and basic commercial reporting will help you get the most from the exercises. No coding is required, but you should be ready to work with contract logs, Excel-based trackers, and sample post-award documents.
